description: This is a Java source file defining the LoginPage class, which implements the Page Object Model for automating interactions with the login page of the OrangeHRM web application. It contains element locators, actions like open and login, and validation methods for error messages.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Page object class representing the login page of OrangeHRM, encapsulating form elements, actions, and validation methods.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Navigates to the login page URL.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with provided credentials, resolving placeholders if necessary.

methods.name: resolveCredentialPlaceholder
methods.description: Resolves credential placeholders to actual values from configuration.

methods.name: isInvalidCredentialsShown
methods.description: Checks if the invalid credentials toast message is displayed.

methods.name: isRequiredShown
methods.description: Checks if the 'Required' validation message is displayed.
